blurb: Starting August 2026, Theatre Tallahassee is launching a year-round education program with something for nearly every age and interest. Just in time for the fall semester, we will be offering After-School classes for students in grades 3-12. These are ongoing, weekly theatrical education classes, that will culminate at the end of each semester with a showcase performance.
